class Registry {
  private constructor(public size: number) {}

  static create(): Registry {
    return new Registry(1);
  }

  static nested(): Registry {
    class Local extends Registry {}
    return new Local(2);
  }
}

class Shape {
  protected constructor(public name: string) {}

  static square(): Shape {
    return new Square();
  }
}

class Square extends Shape {
  constructor() {
    super("square");
  }

  static base(): Shape {
    return new Shape("base");
  }
}

class Circle extends Shape {}

class Ellipse extends Shape {
  static circle(): Shape {
    return new Circle("circle");
  }
}

console.log(Registry.create().size, Registry.nested().size);
console.log(Shape.square().name, Square.base().name, Ellipse.circle().name, new Square().name);
console.log(Registry.nested() instanceof Registry, Ellipse.circle() instanceof Circle);
